title: Google plans to open its first physical Google Store outside of the US "this summer", in Tokyo's Omotesando district, marking Google's 11th physical store (Damien Wilde/9to5Google)
summary: Damien Wilde / 9to5Google: Google plans to open its first physical Google Store outside of the US “this summer”, in Tokyo's Omotesando district, marking Google's 11th physical store — After being exclusive to the United States, the first physical Google Store outside of the region is coming to Tokyo, Japan, in the coming months.
